remarks: Discover modern living in this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home, perfectly situated in the desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. This move-in-ready gem offers a spacious layout with an additional versatile room, ideal for a home office or guest space.  The open-concept kitchen and dining area are designed for both style and functionality, featuring brand-new cabinetry, elegant stone countertops, and state-of-the-art appliances. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout the home, complementing the two fully renovated bathrooms. Step outside to enjoy a newly built deck overlooking a charming backyard, perfect for entertaining or relaxing.  Conveniently located near downtown Stamford, public transportation, and major highways, this home offers both comfort and accessibility.  Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity, schedule your tour today!
